name: True First Person
description: U toggles the game's own first-person view (F11 is HellForge's Armor LUT editor; the key can be changed in the settings), driven as the retail mod drives it: eye position, field of view, near clip, scope blur, weapon and arm placement with your imported placements, bob and sway, head hiding, sleeves and hand grips. F10 opens the settings: the mod's page in DBF-MCM when it is loaded, else the mod's own panel (needs Goose Overlay Host). Page Up opens the placement editor (needs Goose Overlay Host). Switch the First Person Controller off: the two cannot run together.
